30d89b55.text: Aided by his lieutenants, Uther the Lightbringer, Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, and Turalyon, Lothar was able to convince Lordaeron's demi-$r races of the impending threat as well. The Alliance succeeded in gaining the support of the stoic dwarves of Ironforge and a small number of high elves of Quel'Thalas.
30d89b55.title: The Alliance of Lordaeron

bb664155.text: Lord Lothar rallied the remnants of Azeroth's armies after their defeat at Stormwind Keep, and then launched a massive exodus across the sea to the northern kingdom of Lordaeron. Convinced that the Horde would overcome all of humanity if left unchecked, the leaders of the seven $r nations met and agreed to unite in what would become known as the Alliance of Lordaeron.
bb664155.title: The Alliance of Lordaeron

423-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-progress.text: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal.  Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
423-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

424-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-progress.text: Has Grimson the Pale been slain?  Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
424-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

98299-accept.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98299-accept.text:
If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine--be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal. And try not to get bit, $r.
98299-accept.title: Stop the Spread

99-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
